title: Floating Island Lament
description: A surreal painting depicts a giant tearful woman with long braided hair made of tree roots sitting on a stone bench beside a fox-like creature. In the stormy sky above floats a lush island with trees and glowing flowers, struck by lightning from a spiraling comet, while the foreground shows a paint palette and glowing flowers at dusk.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy painting of a giant crying woman with long gray braided hair made of tree roots and red roses, sitting on a stone bench in a mystical landscape at dusk. A fox-like creature covered in spiral symbols sits beside her. Above them a floating island with trees and glowing flowers is struck by lightning from a spiraling comet in a stormy sky. Foreground shows paint palette with colorful paint, glowing flowers, and roots. Dramatic moody atmosphere with intricate details.
